verdict.rationale: Skills run inside Claude, which acts as the built-in assistant. Users can hand work to it by invoking a skill directly with /skill-name, or let Claude load skills automatically. Bundled skills like /run and /verify work without setup, and skill-creator lets Claude build and improve skills itself. Hands-on reports say automatic triggering is unreliable (one cited eval found the skill was never invoked in 56% of cases), so users often have to invoke skills explicitly. Missing for 10: reliable automatic skill triggering, and independent corroboration that delegated tasks succeed end-to-end.
